answer: Make memory the cost. At random, the node asks a key to recall specifics from its own past graded work: a phrase it used, a grade it gave, why. Payouts vest over a 20-epoch horizon and only keys that pass these recall checks collect. A farm can't let its keys wander as interchangeable throwaways; each one must keep and serve a distinct, consistent history, so cost grows with keys times epochs. Fakes break on that reef of their own past, and a failed check burns the unvested pile.
